test_rename_does_not_affect_sequence.title: Verify renaming a tab doesn't break the sequential naming for new tabs

steps.action: Log in to the application with valid credentials
steps.expected: User is logged in and default page loads

steps.action: Navigate to Insights
steps.expected: Insights page loads without errors

steps.action: Identify the removing one Insights widget to be deleted from the list
steps.expected: removing one Insights widget is visible and identifiable in the list

steps.action: Note the current count of items in the list
steps.expected: Current item count is recorded for later comparison

steps.action: Click the delete button or action for the target removing one Insights widget
steps.expected: A confirmation dialog or prompt appears

steps.action: Verify the confirmation dialog displays the correct item being deleted
steps.expected: Dialog shows the name or identifier of the removing one Insights widget

steps.action: Click Confirm/Yes/Delete to proceed with the deletion
steps.expected: Deletion is processed and a success message appears

steps.action: Verify the removing one Insights widget no longer appears in the list
steps.expected: removing one Insights widget is removed from the list view

steps.action: Verify the item count decreased by one
steps.expected: List count reflects the removal

steps.action: Refresh the page and confirm the deletion persisted
steps.expected: The deleted removing one Insights widget does not reappear after refresh

test_save_empty_view_shows_error.title: Verify saving an empty view shows an error or is prevented

steps.action: Log in to the application with valid credentials
steps.expected: User is logged in and default page loads

steps.action: Navigate to Search > Categories
steps.expected: Search Categories page loads without errors

steps.action: Locate the form, input, or control where validation applies
steps.expected: The target input or form is visible

steps.action: Enter invalid data or trigger the error condition for system shows validation error
steps.expected: The invalid input is accepted into the field

steps.action: Attempt to submit or trigger the validation
steps.expected: Validation fires on submit or field blur

steps.action: Verify an error message is displayed near the field or at the top of the form
steps.expected: A clear, descriptive error message appears

steps.action: Verify the error message text is correct and helpful
steps.expected: Error message accurately describes the validation failure

steps.action: Verify the form did not submit or the action was blocked
steps.expected: No data was saved; the user remains on the form

steps.action: Correct the invalid input with valid data
steps.expected: The error message disappears when valid data is entered

steps.action: Set up precondition: when category name is left empty
steps.expected: Precondition is met (when category name is left empty)

steps.action: Submit with the corrected data and verify success
steps.expected: Form submits successfully after correction

test_save_view.title: Verify a view can be saved with content using checkbox selection

steps.action: Navigate to Views page
steps.expected: Views page loads with camera grid

steps.action: Add a new tab and rename it with a unique timestamp name
steps.expected: New tab is created and renamed

steps.action: Expand 'Driver Site' in the camera tree and show cameras
steps.expected: Camera list for Driver Site is visible

steps.action: Select the first available camera via checkbox
steps.expected: Camera is added to the view (thumbnail appears)

steps.action: Click Save View button
steps.expected: 'View saved successfully' message appears

steps.action: Clean up: close the tab and delete the saved view from My Views
steps.expected: 'Successfully deleted' message appears

test_open_my_views.title: Verify the My Views panel opens

steps.action: On Views, click the My Views icon in the panel bar.
steps.expected: The My Views panel opens and shows its Presets and My Views sections.

test_open_saved_view.title: A saved view reopens from My Views after a page refresh

steps.action: Add a tab, rename it, show the site's cameras, tick the first camera and click Save.
steps.expected: The toast View saved successfully shows.

steps.action: Refresh the browser and open My Views.
steps.expected: The saved view is listed under its name.

steps.action: Hover the saved view and tick its checkbox.
steps.expected: The view opens as a tab or fills a tile.

test_delete_saved_view.title: A saved view can be deleted from My Views

steps.action: Add a tab, rename it, show the site's cameras and tick the first camera.
steps.expected: The camera lands in the first tile.

steps.action: Click Save.
steps.expected: The toast View saved successfully shows.

steps.action: Close the tab, open My Views, hover the saved view, click its delete icon and confirm Delete.
steps.expected: The toast Successfully deleted shows and the view is gone from the list.
